contexts.text: The breath of the Spirit of life () = those of the Most Ancient Church who had the breath of lives in their nostrils, that is, the life of love and faith. Explained.
The blast of the breath of Thy nostrils ().

Since the evil are cast down by means of a more vehement influx of Divine truth and good proceeding from the Lord as a Sun, the casting down of those who are in falsities of evil is described by the blast of the nostrils of Jehovah. Illustrated.
